facts: colour Autumn Leaf: warm terracotta / burnt orange, matte prewashed microfiber with a soft crinkle
comforter: SOLID terracotta on both sides, no stripes, no pattern, soft quilting lines, no piping, no logo
2 shams: solid terracotta with a flat flange edge; 2 pillowcases: thin terracotta-and-white stripes
flat sheet and fitted sheet: thin terracotta-and-white stripes, heathered terracotta bands, white bands about as wide; print on one side only, the back is pale
fitted sheet: one sewn striped patch pocket on EACH long side of the bed, on the side drop, phone/book size, open at the top
queen stripes run head to foot on top of the bed
no labels, logos, tags or text anywhere on the bedding
